remarks: First time on the market in 57 years! Welcome to this 3-bedroom, 1.5-bath home located in a quiet and established West Covina neighborhood. Offering a comfortable floor plan, central air and heating, a spacious lot, and plenty of parking, this property is a great opportunity for a buyer looking to make a home their own. The long driveway provides ample parking and leads to a 2-car garage. Conveniently located near shopping, malls, restaurants, schools, and major transportation routes, this home offers both comfort and convenience.
